title: Gears of War: E-Day story director Juan Vaca announces his layoff
description: Juan Vaca said he was affected by Microsoft's layoffs shortly before Gears of War: E-Day's planned launch.
summary: Eurogamer and PC Gamer cover Juan Vaca's announcement that he was laid off from The Coalition. Both reports refer to the same LinkedIn statement and note that Gears of War: E-Day had recently gone gold. Eurogamer published its report on September 23; PC Gamer followed on September 27. The later coverage does not describe a second layoff event.
